name: B10-0235/2025 (Renew) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It asks Cameroon to release journalists held for years without fair trials, and to stop trying civilians in military courts. It asks the European Union to watch trials, visit jailed journalists, consider sanctions on those responsible for abuses, and link cooperation with Cameroon to real progress on human rights and free speech.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only asks Cameroon and the European Union to act.
- It affects jailed journalists, media workers, activists and their families in Cameroon.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies, the African Union and Cameroon's authorities.
